text: CT Chest with Contrast: A 3.5 cm irregular mass is identified in the right lower lobe, associated with mediastinal lymphadenopathy. The largest lymph node measures 2.1 cm in the right paratracheal region. No evidence of distant metastases in the chest. Liver appears unremarkable. Recommend PET-CT for staging and tissue biopsy for definitive diagnosis. IMPRESSION: Concerning for primary lung malignancy with regional lymph node involvement.
